'''''Blechnum appendiculatum''''' is a [[fern]] in the family [[Blechnaceae]].<ref name=CFLW/> It is commonly known as '''hammock fern''',<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Blechnum appendiculatum (Hammock Fern) - FSUS |url=https://fsus.ncbg.unc.edu/main.php?pg=show-taxon.php&parentid=64169 |access-date=2025-03-10 |website=fsus.ncbg.unc.edu |language=en}}</ref> '''sinkhole fern, and New World midsorus fern'''.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Sessa |first=Emily |url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/Ferns_Spikemosses_Clubmosses_and_Quillwo/gtjVEAAAQBAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&dq=Blechnum+appendiculatum&pg=PA191&printsec=frontcover |title=Ferns, Spikemosses, Clubmosses, and Quillworts of Eastern North America |date=2024-03-05 |publisher=Princeton University Press |isbn=978-0-691-21945-5 |pages=192 |language=en}}</ref> Its native range is from the southern United States through Mexico, the Caribbean and Central America to western South America.<ref name=POWO_17058090-1/> It grows in rocky hammocks and moist forests.<ref name=":0" />
